bundle.shortDescription: Documents on your own computer, with SLAI's agents built in
bundle.longDescription: SLAI Documaster: count, convert, merge, organise, edit, read and analyse documents. Everything, including SLAI's language, privacy, safety and quality agents and the model they use, runs on your computer; nothing is uploaded.
